translations.translatedText: # Friday 2.9.2022 (radio)
Budget proposal. Support for Ukraine. Cocaine use. Lingonberry harvest. Weather forecast.
## Budget proposal.
![man](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4240,h_2385,x_0,y_86/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-805523609b9a7d6e04e/1620810549)
Open image viewer
Danske Bank's chief economist Pasi Kuoppamäki wants more employment measures in the budget. Photo: harri fagerholm
In Finland the government's budget proposal is being discussed. The government announced the budget for next year on Thursday. The state is taking on more than 8 billion euros of new debt.

Economic experts say that it will take a long time to balance Finland's economy. For example, Danske Bank's chief economist Pasi Kuoppamäki says that the budget has too few employment measures. University of Helsinki professor Niku Määttänen is worried about how there will be enough money to secure all public services.
The opposition also criticises the government's budget proposal, because Finland is taking on a lot more debt. The opposition means the parties that are not in the government.
## Help for Ukraine

![A Russian shell has destroyed the top floor of an apartment block. Attacks happen almost daily.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5023,h_2818,x_0,y_111/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-10001196308d67c8c585/1661524107)
Open image viewer
A very large number of Ukrainians have lost their homes because of bombings. Photo: Antti Kuronen / Yle

Finland is giving more help to Ukraine. Finland is giving Ukraine help worth 35 million euros. Finland is delivering to Ukraine, for example, food and temporary family housing for people who have lost their homes.
Finland also supports Ukraine's public administration, so that public sector employees can be paid salaries.
Finland is also sending movable accommodation to Ukraine for use by rescue personnel.
## Cocaine use
![drug needle and user](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4406,h_2478,x_0,y_461/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-42376959a2b3e4b0020/1599460038)
Open image viewer
Cocaine is used especially at weekends in the big cities of Southern Finland. Photo: Mostphotos
Use of the drug cocaine has increased in Southern Finland. This is shown by wastewater research.

The Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL) monitors the amount of drugs in wastewater. New results show that cocaine use has grown larger than amphetamine use in the big cities of Southern Finland. Before, amphetamine was the most used drug.
The study shows that cocaine is used especially at weekends. There are big differences between cities. For example, in Tampere or Turku cocaine is used less than in Helsinki.
Amphetamine is used widely across Finland, but the amount has decreased in recent years.
## Lingonberry harvest
![Lingonberries in the forest.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2133,h_1200,x_0,y_400/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7241655f72edfded328/1601367620)
Open image viewer
The summer has been good for lingonberries. Photo: Petri Vironen / Yle

The lingonberry harvest is good this year. The Natural Resources Institute says that the lingonberries had a lot of flowers in the summer and that the pollination of lingonberries went well. The drought has not harmed the growth of lingonberries, because lingonberries thrive in dry and hot conditions.
The lingonberry harvest will be a little bigger than usual. Lingonberries will soon be ready to pick in areas that have been especially warm.
The lingonberry harvest is especially good in Satakunta and in Southern Ostrobothnia.
## The weather
![Saturday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12607590)
Open image viewer
On Saturday it is cloudy and in places it rains.

On Saturday it is cloudy. In the East and in Kainuu it rains. Showers also occur in the middle of the country. The temperature is between 7 and 14 degrees. A gusty north wind adds to the feeling of cold.
